name: diode_rectifier
display: Rectifier/switching diodes (general purpose, switching, fast recovery, SBR, bridges)
__comment_why__: Added 2026-07-07. ONE table for the non-Schottky, non-Zener diode families (~10k parts): general purpose, switching (1N4148 territory), fast-recovery/high-efficiency, super barrier rectifiers, and bridge rectifiers. Route between them with the filterable common column: --where "subcategory ~ Switching" / "~ Fast" / "~ Bridge" / "~ General". Schottky stays in its own diode_schottky recipe.

category_match.subcategory: Diodes - General Purpose|Switching Diode|Fast Recovery|High Effic Rectifier|Super Barrier Rectifier|Bridge Rectifiers

columns: __comment_if__: same 'Rectified Current' reality as the schottky recipe —
and the same substring-trap lore: NO bare 'Io'/'If' aliases, ever.
__comment_trr__: reverse recovery time ('4ns') — THE spec that separates a
freewheeling/PWM-node diode from a mains rectifier. 303/500 coverage in
the sample; filter e.g. --where "trr_s <= 50ns" for fast recovery.
